verdict.rationale: The product supports saved tasks that Siri, Shortcuts, widgets and Control Center can trigger. Those are one-off manual or host-platform triggers, though, and nothing documents a recurring schedule built into the product. The Clock example shows the agent setting an alarm inside an iPhone app, which is a task it performs, not scheduling of its own jobs. Any recurring scheduling would depend on iOS Shortcuts automations, a host-platform workaround that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
